verdict.rationale: Notte has no documented bulk or batch-operation feature. The closest evidence is indirect: 'fast, scalable browsers', serverless Functions you can invoke and schedule, and structured extraction of multi-item lists like a Hacker News feed or the last 10 messages. Together these suggest you could script parallel or repeated runs across many items, but the docs never describe this directly. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API or parallel-session fan-out, documented multi-item action workflows (not just extraction), and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
